name: Campaign Studio
intro: Campaign Studio turns your saved brand and a goal into on-brand campaign concepts, then builds creatives sized for the platforms where you'll publish them.

features.campaign-goal: Start with Campaign Goal. Pick a card such as Product Launch or Brand Awareness, and that goal steers what your concepts are about.
features.optional-direction-or-theme: The direction box is optional. Type a season, offer or angle, like holiday gifting, and your concepts will lean that way.
features.generate-concepts: Generate Concepts asks the AI for four distinct ideas written from your Brand DNA. Each card shows a title, key message, call to action and tone notes.
features.select-a-concept: Click Select on the concept you like. That opens the Assets step, and the creatives are built from the idea you chose.
features.platform-chips: Platform chips let you choose where your creatives will run, from Instagram Feed to YouTube Thumbnail. Each has its own picture shape and copy limits.
features.generate-assets: Generate Assets makes one creative for each platform you picked. You'll see a status row per platform as each one finishes.
features.asset-cards-edit-and-animate: Every finished asset becomes a card with its picture and copy. Edit opens the Asset Editor, and Animate sends the picture on to Animate Studio.
features.view-campaign: View campaign opens a page with the goal, concepts and all your assets together, so you can come back to the whole campaign later.

outro: That's Campaign Studio. Choose a goal, pick a concept, and your platform creatives take shape from there.
